roadman-cycling.name: Roadman Cycling
roadman-cycling.description: MCP server for the Roadman Cycling platform. Provides semantic search over 1,400+ podcast episodes, expert coaching insights, evidence-bounded training methodology, typed research assets, the verified upcoming cycling strength and recovery app identity, product catalogue, events, and community statistics.
